induction l with | nil => rfl | cons a t ih => simp only [List.contains_cons, ih, BEq.congr_left h]

induction l with | nil => rfl | cons a t ih => cases hx : (x == a) <;> cases hy : (y == a) <;> simp_all <;> first | exact absurd (PartialEquivBEq.trans (PartialEquivBEq.symm h) hx) (by simp [hy]) | exact absurd (PartialEquivBEq.trans h hy) (by simp [hx])
